summary: East Haddam, CT 75-ft steel lookout listed as removed with no date; a 2015 state report describes a 120-ft monopole at 194 Mount Parnassus Rd, which it does not tie to the lookout.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists it as removed, with no date. A 2015 state siting report describes an existing 120-foot monopole at 194 Mount Parnassus Road, East Haddam, but does not link it to the lookout.

events.note: Connecticut Siting Council staff report (February 19, 2015) describes an existing 120-foot monopole at 194 Mount Parnassus Road, East Haddam; DESPP sought to replace it with a 120-foot lattice tower. The report does not mention a fire lookout.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build date, staffing, agency or access for the Mount Parnassus lookout. The only status source is the Forest Lookouts 'Removed' label, undated. The 2015 petition describes a 120-foot monopole at 194 Mount Parnassus Road and a planned replacement lattice tower; it does not mention the lookout, and it is not established that the monopole is on the lookout site or that the replacement was built. TopoZone's point (41.4703766, -72.4061965) is roughly 0.6 km from the brief's coordinates (41.472, -72.4125) and gives an elevation of 600 ft (183 m) versus the brief's 173.1 m; TopoZone does not state status. The FFLOS registration date from the brief was not verified. Suggest a site check or local source before changing the status or adding a build date.
